title: Wilkerson et al., Reducing Cache Power with Low-Cost, Multi-bit Error-Correcting Codes (Hi-ECC), ISCA 2010
supports: Strong BCH (5-error correct, 6-error detect) over large lines with disabling of multi-bit-failure lines cuts eDRAM refresh power by ~93% for a 128 MB cache at ~2% storage overhead. Prior art for I-01312 (page-level ECC funding relaxed refresh); 1 KB codeword size not confirmed in snippet (via search snippet)
